package.description: Windows 11 keyboard-layout switcher for converting Russian and English text.

en-US.description: Windows 11 keyboard-layout switcher for converting Russian and English text.
en-US.longDescription: Rust Switcher is a native Windows 11 utility that converts selected text and recently typed words between Russian and English keyboard layouts. It provides configurable hotkeys, optional automatic conversion, a tray icon, settings, and autostart.
en-US.name: Rust Switcher
